title: Coding and scientific tasks in Intelligence Index v5
context: The v5 methodology includes FrontierCode repository changes judged for merge readiness and terminal-based scientific tasks. Its changes to the suite matter when reading scores across releases.

title: GLM-5.2 on knowledge work and coding benchmarks
context: The publisher evaluates GLM-5.2 with Intelligence Index v4.1, GDPval-AA v2 knowledge-work tasks and SciCode. Its cost-per-task comparison uses API pricing.

title: Choosing an evaluation method for a language model
context: The guide contrasts MMLU classification, GSM8K answer checking and HumanEval code execution. It explains how training-data overlap can distort benchmark interpretation.

title: Comparing quantized model configurations in Strata
context: The author compares capability and speed on a Radeon R9700. The model quantization and RAM loading policy both change, limiting what the reported differences can establish about either setting.
